verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering professional legal services, not a software product that a user operates, so operating it through natural-language commands is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions AI/ML legaltech, but it is used internally for contract review, not a user-facing natural-language interface, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
